sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production xianxia RPG inventory equipment sprite atlas. Generate ONE atlas with EXACTLY 7 equal columns and EXACTLY 6 equal rows, 42 separate item sprites, perfectly aligned regular grid, no gutters except transparent padding inside each cell. Requested canvas 1792 by 1536, each cell 256 by 256. Entire background must be genuinely TRANSPARENT. Each item isolated, centered and entirely contained in its own cell with 18 percent transparent margin, no items crossing boundaries. Every column is an ascending tier, left to right: column 1 plain white silver novice gear with no magic, column 2 blue azure refined gear, column 3 green jade botanical gear, column 4 violet royal gear, column 5 orange gold dragon gear, column 6 crimson imperial fire gear, column 7 pink celestial blossom phoenix gear. Each tier must have a DIFFERENT PHYSICAL SILHOUETTE, material, construction and ornament, NOT just recolor the same item. Strong increasing intricacy and power from basic unadorned to elaborate legendary, clearly recognizable at 64px. Row 1: one complete sword per cell, diagonal blade tip up right, simple iron straight sword in first, flowing leaf jade saber in third, broad dragon flame blade in sixth, elegant blossom crescent rapier in seventh. Row 2: one empty full robe/coat per cell, no wearer, novice simple cloth vest first, belted blue coat second, green leaf short mantle third, fur collar violet long robe fourth, gold armored dragon coat fifth, red fire layered imperial coat sixth, pink white flower silk robe seventh. Row 3: one helmet/crown per cell, simple iron cap first progressing to distinct high horned gold crowns, crimson phoenix crown sixth, pink floral diadem seventh. Row 4: a matched pair of boots per cell, ordinary short plain cloth boots first, leather boots second, jade engraved greaves third, tall curved violet boots fourth, dragon gold plated boots fifth, winged red armored boots sixth, elegant pink white lotus boots seventh. Row 5: one ring per cell with an obvious hole, simple plain silver band first, blue round gem ring second, green jade loop third, violet angular amethyst ring fourth, gold dragon ring fifth, crimson ruby phoenix ring sixth, pink rose crystal double band seventh. Row 6: one pendant/amulet per cell, humble stone cord talisman first, blue teardrop second, green carved jade leaf third, purple intricate circular pendant fourth, gold dragon medallion fifth, crimson flame pendant sixth, pink lotus double pendant seventh. Style: polished hand-painted 2.5D Chinese fantasy inventory item art, detailed metallic highlights and silk folds, consistent soft upper left lighting and perspective, restrained item-local magic sparks only on high tiers, transparent exterior around every sprite, crisp distinct contour. No UI cards, no border frames, no background panels, no rarity diamonds, no check marks, no lock icons, no enhancement numbers, no letters, no text, no labels, no watermark, no grid lines, no checkerboard painted into the image.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production game inventory sprite atlas for native weapons of seven xianxia schools. Exactly 7 columns by 7 rows, 49 separate isolated items, evenly spaced regular grid of equal square cells. Transparent background, actual alpha, no background color. Each sprite occupies at most 65 percent of its cell in both directions, center of object exactly center of cell. At least 17 percent fully TRANSPARENT padding on all edges of each cell. No glows or smoke extending into padding. Requested square canvas 1792 by 1792, each cell 256. Polished hand-painted 2.5D Chinese fantasy object art, consistent upper-left light, crisp metallic details, readable at 64px. Each column corresponds to increasing equipment tier: col1 plain white/silver novice, col2 blue azure, col3 green jade and leaves, col4 violet ornate, col5 orange/gold dragon, col6 crimson imperial fire, col7 pink celestial lotus/phoenix. All seven objects in each row MUST have visibly different physical silhouette, construction and ornament matching the tier, not mere recolors. Row1 talisman scrolls: crude short paper seal, long blue hanging paper seal, leaf-shaped jade seal, ornate double violet scroll, gold metal dragon scroll, red fire segmented hanging seal, pink floral fan-shaped talisman. Row2 bows: simple wooden hunting bow, recurved blue steel bow, curving leafy jade bow, double-limbed violet bow, gold dragon bow, crimson flame horn bow, pink phoenix-wing bow. Row3 paired daggers / twin blades: simple matched iron daggers, blue curved twin blades, jade leaf blades, violet hooked blades, gold dragon twin sabers, red flaming jagged blades, pink long crescent twin blades; each pair contained in one cell. Row4 flame magic seals: crude stone flame disk, blue crystal flame cube, green jade triangular fire seal, violet hexagonal seal, golden dragon flame seal, crimson spiked fire crest, pink lotus flame orb seal. Row5 soul banners: plain short cloth pennant on rod, blue ribbon banner, green leaf hanging banner, purple torn double-tail banner, gold black dragon banner, crimson black flame banner, pink phantom lotus banner. Row6 Buddhist staves: simple wooden ring staff, blue silver ring staff, green jade ring staff, violet crescent ring staff, gold dragon multi-ring staff, crimson flame-headed staff, pink lotus multi-ring staff. Row7 jade tablets / codices: plain simple stone tablet, two blue runestone slips tied by cord, green jade leaf tablet, three violet crystal slips, gold engraved dragon codex, red fire stacked tablets, pink lotus petal jade codex. Full complete weapon in every cell, never cut off, no human hands, no people. NO text or characters, NO labels or numbers, NO rarity borders, NO UI frames, NO drawn checkerboard, NO grid lines, NO watermark. The background and all padding must be fully transparent.
